scripts.predev: npm run build --workspace @certiflow/shared && npm run build --workspace @certiflow/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev --workspace @certiflow/web" "npm run start --workspace @certiflow/api" "npm run start:worker --workspace @certiflow/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @certiflow/shared && npm run build --workspace @certiflow/api && npm run build --workspace @certiflow/web
